source: Private owner-held root-conversation export; raw text and private path are not distributed. Verify the complete-byte prefix hash and source line references against that export.

source_prefix.cutoff_reason: Latest completed whole-game README turn before the current report revision; current turn 167 and all later activity excluded.

method.time_measure: Recorded root-assistant ended-turn duration_ms; includes thinking, tools, tests, waits and child-agent coordination. Child sessions are never added. Gaps between root turns are excluded.
method.scope_review: Manually reviewed actual user requests across all included turns and assistant outcomes for ambiguous/deferred/mixed turns. Subject continues until an explicit stage transition; brief follow-up requests inherit that context. No keyword-only classification.
method.stage_attribution: Attribute work to the stage whose delivery prompted it, even when the implementation or regression protection benefits earlier/later stages.
method.shared_work: Whole-game onboarding/setup/workflow, standalone tracker management, recruitment packaging/report delivery, and full-game README are separate shared work.
method.mixed_policy: Keep unsplit mixed turns in a conservative ledger. Separately provide a whole-turn primary-context estimate for mixed setup/timer overhead: turn24 Stage1, turn81 Stage2, turn103 Stage3. The explicitly combined Stage1-report/Stage2-rule-review turn61 remains mixed even in the estimate. No minute-by-minute split is invented.
method.ranges: Allocation ranges are conservative ledger totals to maximum assignment of relevant mixed turns. They are not statistical confidence intervals, do not measure human labor, and upper endpoints across scopes must not be added.

shared_setup_delivery.coverage_note: First/last associated event boundaries; gaps and other scopes between them are not included in this duration.

limitations: Assistant elapsed time is not human labor, TiMaS time, CPU time, or total project effort.
A stage label follows the initiating work context; reusable solver code and shared regressions cross stage boundaries.
Even stage-specific turns contain routine communication and tooling overhead, which cannot be reliably removed.
Mixed-turn allocations have genuine uncertainty; the conservative ledger and allocation ranges preserve it.
This is one root conversation, not unrelated conversations; parallel child work is included only through elapsed root waiting and is never summed again.
Current report revision is excluded to preserve a stable completed-turn cutoff and avoid recursively recounting the report that cites this audit.
Per-start-date daily rows keep entire turns on the start date and are not clock-midnight splits.
Recorded duration_ms and source event-timestamp intervals use slightly different boundaries; sub-second digits support reproducibility, not precision about human work.
